newsitem.title: POLAND: Optimus sees Internet profit growth H2 '97.
newsitem.headline: Optimus sees Internet profit growth H2 '97.

text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA expects its new Internet service OptimusNet to bring profits from mid-1997, the company's president said on Wednesday.
"At present we spend more (on OptimusNet) than we earn, but we see the turning point in mid-1997," Roman Kluska told a news conference.
Kluska said that so far the company had spent about one million zlotys for creating and offering the service it had set up in June this year.
He did not give any figures for the service's expected profit growth in 1997.
